events.title: Deutsche Bank sees new upswing for health insurers after years of margin pressure
events.body: Investing.com -- Analysts at Deutsche Bank turned more bullish on the managed care sector, upgrading shares of Humana, Centene, and Elevance Health to “Buy,” while downgrading The Cigna Group to “Hold” on valuation concerns.
